onClick={() => { setViewRole("CLIENTE"); if (queueFilter === "PRODUCT_SEND") setQueueFilter("ALL"); if (surface === "TALENTS" || surface === "WORK" || surface === "CLIENTS" || surface === "CONTRACTS" || surface === "AGENCIES" || surface === "MACROS") setSurface("PUBLICATIONS"); }}

onClick={async () => { const saved = await perform({ action: "SET_TALENT_GLOBAL_STATUS", talentId: selected.id, status: selected.status === "BAJA" ? "ACTIVO" : "BAJA", reason: statusReason, note: statusNote, confirmed: true }, "Estado actualizado."); if (saved) { setStatusOpen(false); setStatusReason(""); setStatusNote(""); } }}

onClickCapture={(event) => { if (surface !== "TALENTS" || !talentDirty) return; if (!(event.target instanceof Element) || !event.target.closest(".surface-nav button, .global-results button")) return; if (!window.confirm("Hay cambios sin guardar en la ficha. ¿Salir y descartarlos?")) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); } }}

onDismiss={() => { if (uppyActiveRef.current) return; uppyTransfer?.dispose(); if (uppyTransferRef.current === uppyTransfer) uppyTransferRef.current = null; setUppyTransfer(null); setUppySelection(null); }}
onDrop={uppyDropEnabled ? event => { event.preventDefault(); if (!busy && !filePending && event.dataTransfer.files.length) void uploadSelectedFile(event.dataTransfer.files[0]); } : undefined}
onOpenChange={(open) => { setNoticesOpen(open); if (open) void refreshState().catch(() => setError("No se pudieron actualizar los avisos.")); }}
onOpenCreator={(creatorId) => { const creator = creators.find(item => item.id === creatorId); if (creator) openCreatorProfile(creator); }}
onOpenMaterial={(deliverableId) => { const item = deliverables.find(entry => entry.id === deliverableId); if (item) openDeliverable(item); }}

onOpenWorkGroup={(group) => { const first = group[0]; if (!first || data.actor.role !== "OPERADOR") return; setHomeDetailId(""); setCampaignId(first.campaignId); setCreatorId(first.creatorId); setDeliverableId(""); // Sin filtro: el mensaje existente de Seguimiento reúne todas las // decisiones vigentes del creador, incluso si hay varias piezas. setCommunicationReviewIds([]); setCommunicationCreatorId(first.creatorId); }}
onRetry={() => { if (!uppyTransfer || uppyActiveRef.current) return; uppyActiveRef.current = true; void uppyTransfer.retry().finally(() => { uppyActiveRef.current = false; }); }}
onChange={event=>{ const file=event.currentTarget.files?.[0]; event.currentTarget.value=""; if(file) void uploadDocument(item.kind,file); }}
onChange={event => {setDraft(current => ({...current, agreementStatus: event.target.value as Draft["agreementStatus"]})); setNotice("");}}
onClick={() => setDraft(current => ({...current, actions: current.actions.filter(item => item.id !== action.id)}))}
